_comment: Poseidon sea-creature catch registry. Keyed by the in-world nameplate name; value = exact catch chat line. Multi-entity catches count as one SC (bind one representative plate). The 'A gang of Liltads!' catch is keyed as 'Tadgang' (the title the whole gang uses); we track a single one. Blank values fall back to the positional scan. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
Sea Witch: It looks like you've disrupted the Sea Witch's brewing session. Watch out, she's furious!
Sea Archer: You reeled in a Sea Archer.
Rider of the Deep: The Rider of the Deep has emerged.
Guardian Defender: You've discovered a Guardian Defender of the sea.
Deep Sea Protector: You have awoken the Deep Sea Protector, prepare for a battle!
Water Hydra: The Water Hydra has come to test your strength.
Trash Gobbler: The Trash Gobbler is hungry for you!
Dumpster Diver: A Dumpster Diver has emerged from the swamp!
Banshee: The desolate wail of a Banshee breaks the silence.
Bayou Sludge: A swampy mass of slime emerges, the Bayou Sludge!
Alligator: A long snout breaks the surface of the water. It's an Alligator!
Titanoboa: A massive Titanoboa surfaces. It's body stretches as far as the eye can see.
Atoll Croaker: An inquisitive Atoll Croaker takes the bait!
Lotus Guardian: A Lotus Guardian emerges, ready to protect the Atoll.
gorF: What even is that?! A... gorF?
Drowned Captain: A Drowned Captain takes hold of your bobber!
Puddle Jumper: A Puddle Jumper is preparing for liftoff—cast your rod into it and hold on tight!
Frog Prince: Bow down before the Frog Prince... or pay the hefty price!
Ent: You've hooked an Ent, as ancient as the forest itself.
The Loch Emperor: The Loch Emperor arises from the depths.
Nessie: You've caused a disturbance in the loch. Could it be... Nessie?
Magma Slug: From beneath the lava appears a Magma Slug.
Moogma: You hear a faint Moo from the lava... A Moogma appears.
Lava Leech: A small but fearsome Lava Leech emerges.
Pyroclastic Worm: You feel the heat radiating as a Pyroclastic Worm surfaces.
Lava Flame: A Lava Flame flies out from beneath the lava.
Fire Eel: A Fire Eel slithers out from the depths.
Thunder: You hear a massive rumble as Thunder emerges.
Lord Jawbus: You have angered a legendary creature... Lord Jawbus has arrived.
Fried Chicken: Smells of burning. Must be a Fried Chicken.
Volcanic Snail: You feel a burning sensation as you reel in a Volcanic Snail!
Fireproof Witch: Trouble's brewing, it's a Fireproof Witch!
Magma Pillar: A Magma Pillar rises from the lava.
Fiery Scuttler: A Fiery Scuttler inconspicuously waddles up to you, friends in tow.
Ragnarok: The sky darkens and the air thickens. The end times are upon us: Ragnarok is here.
Frozen Steve: Frozen Steve fell into the pond long ago, never to resurface...until now!
Frosty: It's a snowman! He looks harmless.
Grinch: The Grinch stole Jerry's Gifts...get them back!
Nutcracker: You found a forgotten Nutcracker laying beneath the ice.
Reindrake: A Reindrake forms from the depths.
Nightmare: You hear trotting from beneath the waves, you caught a Nightmare.
Werewolf: It must be a full moon, a Werewolf appears.
Phantom Fisher: The spirit of a long lost Phantom Fisher has come to haunt you.
Grim Reaper: This can't be! The manifestation of death himself!
Nurse Shark: A tiny fin emerges from the water, you've caught a Nurse Shark.
Blue Shark: You spot a fin as blue as the water it came from, it's a Blue Shark.
Tiger Shark: A striped beast bounds from the depths, the wild Tiger Shark!
Great White Shark: Hide no longer, a Great White Shark has tracked your scent and thirsts for your blood!
Frog Man: Is it a frog? Is it a man? Well, yes, sorta, IT'S FROG MAN!!!!!!
Inkling: You get an inkling you've caught... an Inkling!
Snapping Turtle: A Snapping Turtle is coming your way, and it's ANGRY!
Manta Ray: A majestic creature rises from the water. It's a Manta Ray.
Blue Ringed Octopus: A garish set of tentacles arise. It's a Blue Ringed Octopus!
Wiki Tiki: The water bubbles and froths. A massive form emerges- you have disturbed the Wiki Tiki! You shall pay the price.
Mithril Grubber: A leech of the mines surfaces... you've caught a Mithril Grubber.
Bloated Mithril Grubber: A leech of the mines surfaces... you've caught a Bloated Mithril Grubber.
Large Mithril Grubber: A leech of the mines surfaces... you've caught a Large Mithril Grubber.
Medium Mithril Grubber: A leech of the mines surfaces... you've caught a Medium Mithril Grubber.
Oasis Sheep: An Oasis Sheep appears from the water.
Oasis Rabbit: An Oasis Rabbit appears from the water.
Carrot King: Is this even a fish? It's the Carrot King!
Agarimoo: Your Chumcap Bucket trembles, it's an Agarimoo.
Flaming Worm: A Flaming Worm surfaces from the depths!
Lava Blaze: A Lava Blaze has surfaced from the depths!
Lava Pigman: A Lava Pigman arose from the depths!
Abyssal Miner: An Abyssal Miner breaks out of the water!
Haggard: A Haggard stumbles to the shore, ready for a fight!
Brineling: A Brineling interrupts you with a stream of bubbles!
Sprawl: A Sprawl emerges from the blue, and it's looking for you!
Torrid: The laughter of a Torrid echoes through the air.
Silkbreeze: Something zips through the air - it's a Silkbreeze!
Giant Isopod: A Giant Isopod was dredged up from the depths!
